namespace.description: Namespace where all Sedai components will be deployed

globalLabels.description: Labels that will be added to all resources created by this chart

globalAnnotations.description: Annotations that will be added to all resources created by this chart

clusterName.description: Unique name for your Kubernetes cluster

sedaiApiToken.description: API token (use this OR provide a Kubernetes Secret)

sedaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Sedai platform

clusterProvider.description: Cloud provider / Kubernetes distribution, matching core's KubernetesClusterProvider enum

connectionType.description: Agent-to-server connection type. Empty uses the agent's own default (WS).

enabled.description: Enables Sedai-managed Prometheus for metric collection
Enables deployment of Kube State Metrics
